description: Total sales quantity for the current year
input_question: How many units did we sell this year?
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(Quantity) AS Total_Units FROM SALES WHERE YEAR(Date) = YEAR(CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
notes: Quantity column name and table may differ per deployment schema.

description: Top 5 customers by revenue last year
input_question: Who are the top 5 customers by revenue last year?
expected_sql: SELECT TOP 5 Customer_Name, SUM(Amount) AS Total_Revenue FROM SALES WHERE YEAR(Date) = YEAR(CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) - 1 GROUP BY Customer_Name ORDER BY Total_Revenue DESC
notes: Revenue column may be named Amount, Sales_Amount, or Revenue depending on schema.

description: Total bookings for the current month
input_question: What is the total number of bookings this month?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Total_Bookings FROM BOOKINGS WHERE YEAR(Date) = YEAR(CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) AND MONTH(Date) = MONTH(CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
notes: Date column name may differ per deployment schema.

description: Sales by country for the past 12 months
input_question: Show me sales broken down by country for the last 12 months.
expected_sql: SELECT Ship_To_Country, SUM(Amount) AS Total_Sales FROM SALES WHERE Date >= DATEADD(MONTH, -12, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) GROUP BY Ship_To_Country ORDER BY Total_Sales DESC
notes: Country column is Ship_To_Country in the default schema.

description: Monthly sales trend for current year
input_question: Give me the monthly sales trend for this year.
expected_sql: SELECT MONTH(Date) AS Month, SUM(Amount) AS Monthly_Sales FROM SALES WHERE YEAR(Date) = YEAR(CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) GROUP BY MONTH(Date) ORDER BY Month
notes: May be rendered with a PIVOT for readability.

input_question: How many open orders do we have?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Open_Orders FROM BOOKINGS

description: Sales for a specific sales rep
input_question: What were the total sales for sales rep John Smith last quarter?
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(Amount) AS Total_Sales FROM SALES WHERE SalesRep_Name LIKE '%John%' AND SalesRep_Name LIKE '%Smith%' AND Date >= DATEADD(QUARTER, -1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
notes: Uses LIKE with wildcards for name matching as per bot rules.

input_question: What are the top 10 parts by number of bookings?
expected_sql: SELECT TOP 10 Part_Number, COUNT(*) AS Booking_Count FROM BOOKINGS GROUP BY Part_Number ORDER BY Booking_Count DESC
notes: Uses TOP instead of LIMIT per MSSQL convention.

description: Sales and bookings combined for a product group
input_question: Show total sales and bookings for product group PG_X.
expected_sql: SELECT 'Sales' AS Source, SUM(Amount) AS Total FROM SALES WHERE PG LIKE '%PG_X%' UNION ALL SELECT 'Bookings' AS Source, SUM(Amount) AS Total FROM BOOKINGS WHERE PG LIKE '%PG_X%'
notes: Combines both tables with UNION ALL.

input_question: Compare total sales this year vs last year.
expected_sql: SELECT YEAR(Date) AS Year, SUM(Amount) AS Total_Sales FROM SALES WHERE YEAR(Date) IN (YEAR(CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)), YEAR(CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) - 1) GROUP BY YEAR(Date) ORDER BY Year
notes: Simple aggregation; could also be expressed with PIVOT.
